## Outcome
Done: `formatReceipt` is added to `src/money.ts`, and `formatCents` is corrected so the SPEC examples hold. The reviewer loop was not run; I did not delegate, since I was given the implementation task only.

## Changes
- `src/money.ts:2-10` `formatCents`: the old version gave `$1.5` for 105 and `$-3.-50` for -250. It now handles the sign before the dollar sign and pads cents to two digits. This changes existing behaviour, and it was needed because `formatReceipt` depends on it.
- `src/money.ts:12-18` `formatReceipt` (new): one `<label>: <formatCents>` line per item, then `Total: <formatCents(sum)>`, joined with `\n`.

## Verification
- All six SPEC examples checked with node against the file: `formatCents(0)`, `(105)`, `(123456)`, `(-250)`, the Tea/Refund receipt, and the empty list. All returned true.
- No test suite was run; the repo has no test for this file that I know of.
